title: HHHusher product hero (v2)
description: A near-black product page opening: on the left a 1.7:1 picture in a hairline 5px frame, a row of four thumbnails and thin bronze arrows (a 1/4 counter on phones); on the right a light, large two-line product name, a price row (struck-through old price, bold new price, an outlined discount tag and a mono 'limited' note), two paragraphs, then a grey quantity stepper with cream square buttons, a yellow checkout button and a small mono guarantee.
notes: always dark (forces the dark class); sits under the fixed hhhusher-v2-header
one media slot per picture; thumbnails reuse them
needs JavaScript for the gallery and the stepper (hydrate: load); without it the first picture and quantity 1 show
name: hhhusher-v2-product-hero

props.name: name
props.description: the product name; use \n to break it into two lines

props.name: price
props.description: the current price, as shown (e.g. "$289 USD")

props.name: tag
props.description: the outlined tag next to the price (e.g. "-15%")

props.name: tagNote
props.description: the small mono note after the tag

props.name: paragraphs
props.description: one or more paragraphs under the price

props.name: pictures
props.description: pictures for the gallery (up to four thumbnails show)

props.name: note
props.description: the small mono guarantee next to (desktop) or under (phone) the button

props.name: labels
props.type: { previous: string; next: string; less: string; more: string; quantity: string; }
props.description: screen-reader labels for the arrows and the stepper
